item.title: IG: Special education transportation woes demand ‘meaningful action’
item.description: Massachusetts' unusual reimbursement model for special education transportation is straining local school budgets and driving inequities, according to a new report from the inspector general.

item.title: Deposed Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro asks judge to toss out indictment against him
item.description: Maduro's attorney says the U.S. government violated his client’s due process rights by blocking funds.

item.title: The Five Minute Read
item.description: The Five Minute Read highlights things to do, places to go and people to know in the Greater Lowell area. Have news to share? Send it to news@lowellsun.com. Submissions must be received at least one week in advance to be considered for publication. Submitted photographs should be at least 300 KB in JPG format.

item.title: Bruins return to play with big win over Columbus, 4-2
item.description: Joonas Korpisalo was the Bruins best player by a large margin, leading them to victory with a 36-save performance over Columbus.

item.title: Editorial: Ease small retailers’ burden by removing Lottery sales inclusion
item.description: On Thursday, the Senate scheduled deliberations on legislation designed to provide support for small neighborhood markets and convenience stores facing economic challenges in an environment largely dominated by supermarket chains. The bill targets the requirement of unit pricing labels on items sold in these stores, an expense larger retailers can more easily afford.
